cases.name: register_no_label
cases.note: label is omitempty: it must be absent, not an empty string

cases.name: register_preferred_device_id
cases.note: v4: preferredDeviceId without idCert is ignored and a fresh id is minted

cases.name: register_with_id_cert
cases.note: v4: idCert is the registry's certificate from an earlier register_ok or hello_ok; it restores preferredDeviceId; both omitted when empty

cases.name: register_ok_existing
cases.note: v4: idCert is always present; clients store it opaquely (Keychain account device-id-cert)

cases.name: register_ok_leading_zero
cases.note: deviceId keeps leading zeros; it is a string, never a number

cases.name: hello_ok_with_active_session
cases.note: v4: iceServers is STUN only, never credentials; idCert certifies the authenticated binding

cases.name: hello_ok_no_active_session
cases.note: activeSessionId and idCert are omitempty; iceServers may be empty

cases.name: heartbeat
cases.note: no fields: payload must be {} and never null

cases.name: presence_never_seen
cases.note: since is 0 when never seen, and 0 is NOT omitempty on this type

cases.name: connect_req
cases.note: v1: carries the plaintext access code; never log this frame

cases.name: connect_req_v2_no_access_code
cases.note: v2: only deviceId; accessCode is omitempty and must be absent, not empty

cases.name: connect_ok
cases.note: hostPubkey is what the controller requires on the host's signed sdp

cases.name: connect_ok_with_ice_servers
cases.note: v5: iceServers is STUN only; TURN arrives in ice_servers once the session is metered

cases.name: connect_ok_no_host_pubkey
cases.note: hostPubkey is omitempty: absent, never an empty string

cases.name: session_start
cases.note: connect_ok plus controllerPubkey, which the host keys its guess policy on; v5 iceServers STUN only, as in connect_ok

cases.name: session_start_no_controller_pubkey
cases.note: controllerPubkey is omitempty: absent, never an empty string

cases.name: resume_ok
cases.note: token is rotated; the old one is dead

cases.name: renew_ok
cases.note: v5: a metered session's renew_ok carries fresh TURN credentials, valid 10 min

cases.name: renew_ok_no_ice_servers
cases.note: v5: iceServers is absent while the session is not metered

cases.name: ice_servers
cases.note: v5: pushed to both peers when the host's first sdp starts metering; the complete list, TURN username <expiry>:<sessionId>, valid 10 min

cases.name: peer_state_detached
cases.note: attached:false must be present, not omitted

cases.name: sdp_offer

payload.sdp:
v=0
o=- 0 0 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
m=application 9 UDP/DTLS/SCTP webrtc-datachannel
a=fingerprint:sha-256 7B:8C:1D:4F:2A:90:33:AE:BB:01:5C:6D:77:E8:99:0A:1B:2C:3D:4E:5F:60:71:82:93:A4:B5:C6:D7:E8:F9:0A
a=setup:actpass

cases.note: fp, pubkey, sig and (v3) mac bind the DTLS fingerprints to the device key and the PAKE; the server relays them unchecked

cases.name: sdp_restart
cases.note: restart is omitempty when false

cases.name: sdp_two_fingerprints
cases.note: several fingerprints are sorted and joined with a newline

cases.name: ice_end_of_candidates
cases.note: empty candidate means end-of-candidates

cases.name: bye_peer_auth_failed
cases.note: the peer's signed SDP fingerprints did not verify

cases.name: bye_auth_failed
cases.note: the host refused the access code, or refused to try one from a locked-out controller

cases.name: bye_declined
cases.note: the host proved the code but its owner declined the connection, or did not answer in 30 s

cases.name: bye_host_relay_report
cases.note: v5 additive: the host's own measurement of the route it took. Read only from the host's bye, and never priced (PROTOCOL.md §2.14.1). A bye without these two fields is unchanged — every other bye vector here proves it

cases.name: bye_displaced
cases.note: v4: the server ended the session because the device id was restored to its certified key

cases.name: bye_no_balance
cases.note: v5 additive: the server ended the session because the host's account has no credit left. Sent only by the server, to both peers, and the one reason neither peer could otherwise learn — the money path used to send host_ended, which told the controller the host hung up

cases.name: error_bye_reason_rejected

payload.message: bye reason is not one of the defined reasons

cases.note: v4: a bye whose reason is not in byeReasons is answered with this and never relayed

cases.name: error_forbidden_role

payload.message: only a controller connection may send connect_req

cases.note: v4: connect_req from a connection that said hello as host

cases.name: pake_step1
cases.note: v5: step is an integer 1..3; the server re-encodes the payload it validated, never the client bytes

cases.name: pake_step3
cases.note: the controller's confirmation ends the exchange

cases.name: error_bad_relay

payload.message: relay payload: step must be an integer 1..3

cases.note: v5: a relayed payload outside its exact schema (see relay.rejected) is answered with this and never relayed

cases.name: error_rate_limited
cases.note: retryAfterSec present only here

payload.message: device already has a remote session

cases.name: error_entitlement
cases.note: v2: reason is present only on the entitlement code

cases.name: mouse_drag_middle
cases.note: reliable on purpose: a dropped drag point visibly breaks window dragging

cases.name: key_down_cmd_c
cases.note: kVK_ANSI_C with Command; the chars field is absent for a shortcut

cases.name: key_down_with_chars
cases.note: chars present: a host may inject the text and ignore the macOS keycode

cases.name: key_down_unicode_chars
cases.note: chars is arbitrary UTF-8, not ASCII

cases.name: key_down_all_mods
cases.note: every defined modifier bit set

cases.name: scroll_natural_down
cases.note: positive dy = content moves up (macOS natural); Windows wheel is inverted

cases.name: scroll_negative_fractional
cases.note: sub-pixel deltas must not be truncated to zero by a notch-based host

cases.name: clipboard_text
cases.note: contents are never logged

cases.name: input_reset
cases.note: no fields; must be idempotent on the receiver

cases.name: display_info_scale_one
cases.note: a non-Retina host; scale 1 is present, not omitted

cases.name: display_info_windows
cases.note: os field present; a controller that predates it must ignore it, not fail

cases.name: display_info_os_absent_means_macos
cases.note: os is omitempty; absent is the macOS default

cases.name: pong
cases.note: echoes ping.t verbatim

cases.name: cursor_shape_arrow
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_ibeam
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_crosshair
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_pointing_hand
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_open_hand
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_closed_hand
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_resize_lr
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_resize_ud
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_resize_diag_nesw
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_resize_diag_nwse
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_not_allowed
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: cursor_shape_busy
cases.note: host -> controller, sent on change only

cases.name: mouse_move
cases.note: receiver must drop any packet whose seq is <= the highest already seen

cases.name: mouse_move_large_seq
cases.note: seq is int64 and must not be narrowed to 32 bits

relay.note: PROTOCOL.md v5: sdp, ice and pake payloads are decoded into their exact schema (exact-case keys, each once, no null, no unknown key, per-field limits) and re-encoded; every implementation accepts exactly the accepted inputs, producing output, and refuses every rejected input.
